### If you are submitting a new theme, please make sure it meets the following requirements:

1. It **MUST** be meaningfully different than the default Adwaita theme and any other existing included theme. If I put it side by side with another theme and can't tell the difference, it will be rejected.
2. It cannot include any custom css aside from what is provided in Rewaita's theme generator.
3. Do not define `--accent-bg-color` or `--accent-fg-color` in your theme. Accents are handled by Rewaita so do not include it.
